items.declaration: RecordID bigint PK + 字典名 nvarchar(256) + 名称 nvarchar(256) + 助记码 nvarchar(256) + 父级ID + RTID
items.interpretation: Dictionary header: 28 flat categories (学历/民族/职位/...). MDM-000D R1 already curated these into seed candidates.

items.declaration: RecordID int PK + Sequence int + RN decimal(32,0) + 编码 nvarchar(256) + 名称 nvarchar(256) + 助记码 nvarchar(256)
items.interpretation: Dictionary item: Code + Name + 助记码 (memory aid). This is the only DEV table that explicitly separates Code (immutable) from Name (display). MDM-000D R1 uses this Code+Name pattern for all reference data.

items.sourceColumn: 凭证号/凭证字/凭证字号
items.declaration: 凭证号 nvarchar(256) NOT NULL + 凭证字 nvarchar(256) + 凭证字号 int
items.interpretation: Voucher 3-part: 字 (type) + 号 (number) + 字号 (int suffix). China accounting convention.

状态表 is a single 17-col generic status reference. Per-document-type status machine (DocumentStatus enum) is the more modern pattern (see BASE-000 P0-11/P0-14). DEV single-table pattern may be adapted if GuliERP wants a flat cross-cutting status registry.

items.declaration: No 客户表 / 供应商表 / 外协表 in DEV biz-tables.json
items.interpretation: BP info is scattered as fields on 商品表 (客户号 / 供应号 / 客户料号 / 供应商品号). DEV has NO dedicated BP master. Whether GuliERP wants a dedicated BP entity is a CONVENTION decision — left UNKNOWN at evidence stage.

observations.evidence: 商品表 has 10+ code-like fields mixing primary + cross-reference.
observations.impact: GuliERP may want to separate PRIMARY (one per tenant) from CROSS_REFERENCE (many per source system).

observations.evidence: 商品表 sample: 品号='1000001' (pure 7-digit numeric, no category info).
observations.impact: Numeric codes do not carry category. GuliERP may adopt structured prefix.
observations.decisionReasoning: Numeric style is REUSE; structured prefix is a design choice — ADAPT.

observations.evidence: 商品表 sample: 客户号='+', 供应号='+' (literal + as null-marker).
observations.impact: Anti-pattern. GuliERP should use proper SQL NULL.
observations.decisionReasoning: Evidence documents the anti-pattern. Whether GuliERP rejects it is a CONVENTION decision — UNKNOWN at evidence stage.

observations.evidence: 仓库表.仓库 nvarchar(256) NOT NULL used as code (name-as-code).
observations.impact: Name and code conflated. GuliERP may want separate Code + Name.

observations.evidence: 字典表s has 编码 (Code) + 名称 (Name) + 助记码 (memory aid).
observations.impact: DEV Dictionary is the only place with explicit Code+Name separation. MDM-000D R1 already uses this pattern.

observations.evidence: No 客户表 / 供应商表 / 外协表 in DEV. BP info lives as 商品表 fields.
observations.impact: DEV has no dedicated BP entity. Whether GuliERP wants one is a CONVENTION decision.

gap_to_convention.p0_referenced: P0-09 BP Code Format + Address/Contact (BASE-002) and P0-10 Item Master (BASE-002)
must_decide: Item code: pure numeric (DEV pattern) vs structured FG-/RM-/SF- prefix
BP code: pure numeric (DEV pattern) vs CUST-/SUPP-/SUB-/LOG- prefix
Cross-reference codes: per-item (DEV pattern) vs per-BP entity
Warehouse code: name-as-code (DEV pattern) vs separate Code+Name
Dictionary code: per-dictionary-enum (DEV pattern) vs per-CONFIG+per-TENANT
BP entity: NONE in DEV vs DEDICATED in GuliERP
